kinds.identical: same rule, same effect; one implementation serves both
kinds.parameter: same mechanic, different constant; an edition flag suffices
kinds.structural: a mechanic, legal action or state exists in one edition and not the other, or reverses
kinds.unknown: not established from printed art in either edition; must not be guessed

module_defects.defect: not printed art. A redraw that bakes in third-party house rules: the Building row reads 'Double Defence / Except Cavalry with 2020 Rules', a reference to Philip Sabin's April 2020 tweaks. It also omits the doubling that the 2nd Edition's printed TEC grants to Woods/Road hexes, and asserts that Woods/Road blocks artillery line of sight. None of this is traceable to printed 3rd-Edition art.
module_defects.severity: must not be used as the source for E14 or E15

module_defects.module: both (shipped in the Oliver and davejm modules)
module_defects.defect: a retimed edit of the printed [9.2]-[9.4] text. Every turn number is shifted one turn earlier and the substituted words are set in a heavier face than the surrounding type: the sheet reads 'Game-Turn Four' where the printed rules read Game-Turn Five, and 'Game-Turn Two' where the printed rules read Game-Turn Three. The variant counters are additionally labelled 'Var' where printed [9.1] specifies '5v'.
module_defects.severity: not citable; and it silently changes the variant's schedule

module_defects.defect: the Grouchy variant does not exist in the Second Edition at all. A module labelled 2nd Ed ships a variant board for a subsystem that edition never had.

module_defects.asset: images/Map to use 3 copy.jpg vs images/Grouchy Variant.jpg
module_defects.defect: internally inconsistent: the map's own Time Record marks Prussian entry at 3 pm (Game-Turn 3), while the bundled Grouchy sheet describes the normal Prussian contingent as arriving on Game-Turn Two.
module_defects.severity: the module contradicts itself on the single most edition-defining constant

module_defects.defect: a 2nd Edition nameplate ships inside the 3rd Edition module, suggesting it was derived from the Oliver module without retitling.
module_defects.severity: cosmetic, but it is why the two modules cannot be told apart by asset inspection alone

module_art_verified_good.finding: a clean reproduction of the printed 2nd Edition Combat Resolution Table. Independently confirms the folio transcription in all 60 cells plus the clamp footnote.
a clean reproduction of the printed 2nd Edition Terrain Effects Chart, word for word including the Towns & Woods/Roads grouping and the Woods entry prohibition.

a faithful restoration of the printed 2nd Edition map: unnumbered hexes, at-start unit pictures, Demoralization Scale 1-40, Time Record with Prussian entry at 2 pm, Exited French Units box, north-edge exit arrows, and the full village set including Ohain, Maransart and Maison du Roi.
a redraw, but its 60 cells agree exactly with the printed 2nd Edition table under the Ae/Ee/De rename.

carries readable four-digit hex numbers 0101 to 2317, the Time Record with Prussian entry at 3 pm listing the same nine units as the 2nd Edition, a seven-slot Exited French Units box and north-edge exit arrows.
